bosses.name: Anub'Rekhan
bosses.general: Locust Swarm: he walks slowly while the swarm shreds everyone near; kite him round the room. Impale in a line; Crypt Guards come.
bosses.tank: Kite him during Locust Swarm; off-tank the Crypt Guards.
bosses.healer: Stay out of the swarm; heal the impaled.
bosses.dps: Kill the Crypt Guards; spread against Impale; never stand in the swarm.

bosses.name: Grand Widow Faerlina
bosses.general: Enrages: a priest mind controls a Naxxramas Worshipper and sacrifices it (Widow's Embrace) to stop the enrage. Rain of Fire, Poison Bolt Volley.
bosses.tank: Tanks on the followers; main tank on Faerlina.
bosses.healer: Cure poison, step out of Rain of Fire.
bosses.dps: Kill the followers, leave the worshippers for the priests.

bosses.name: Maexxna
bosses.general: Web Wrap cocoons players on the wall (break them free), Web Spray stuns everyone every 40 seconds, Necrotic Poison cuts healing on the tank, enrage at 30%.
bosses.tank: Cure the poison quickly; big hits after each web spray.
bosses.healer: Top the tank before Web Spray; cure Necrotic Poison.
bosses.dps: Ranged free the web-wrapped; area the spiderlings.

bosses.name: Noth the Plaguebringer
bosses.general: Blinks (threat reset) and curses everyone; teleports to the balcony and skeleton waves come.
bosses.tank: Pick him up after each blink; hold the skeletons.
bosses.dps: Watch threat after blinks; area the skeletons.

bosses.name: Heigan the Unclean
bosses.general: The safety dance: eruptions sweep the room's four zones in turn; move to the safe zone. On the platform phase everyone dances faster.
bosses.tank: Dance with him through the zones.
bosses.healer: Healers on the platform; cure disease.
bosses.dps: Follow the dance; nobody stands in an erupting zone.

bosses.name: Loatheb
bosses.general: Corrupted Mind lets each healer cast one heal a minute: healers take turns. Spores spawn, standing in a spore cloud gives crits. Inevitable Doom kills slowly later on.
bosses.tank: Use healthstones and potions; shadow protection helps.
bosses.healer: Follow the healing rotation: one big heal when it is your turn.
bosses.dps: Rotate through the spores for the crit bonus.

bosses.name: Instructor Razuvious
bosses.general: Only Death Knight Understudies, mind controlled by priests, can tank him. Disrupting Shout drains mana; Unbalancing Strike.
bosses.tank: Priests control the understudies and use their taunt and shield wall in turn.
bosses.dps: Burn him while the understudies tank.

bosses.name: Gothik the Harvester
bosses.general: Split the raid on both sides of the gate: live adds come on one side, their spirits on the other. The gate opens later; then Gothik comes down.
bosses.tank: Tanks on both sides gather the adds.
bosses.dps: Kill live adds on their side; spirits on the dead side.

bosses.name: Thane Korth'azz
bosses.general: The Four Horsemen: each leaves marks that stack on everyone near; tanks rotate between the four corners. Korth'azz casts Meteor on his tank's group.
bosses.dps: Everyone near Korth'azz shares his Meteor.

bosses.name: Highlord Mograine
bosses.general: Four Horsemen: Righteous Fire on his tank; marks stack.
bosses.dps: Melee kill him with Korth'azz in turn.

bosses.name: Lady Blaumeux
bosses.general: Four Horsemen: Void Zones under players. Kill her from range.

bosses.name: Sir Zeliek
bosses.general: Four Horsemen: Holy Wrath chains between players standing close.

bosses.name: Patchwerk
bosses.general: Hateful Strike hits the melee with the most health besides the tank: three or four tanks soak it. Pure damage race, enrage at 5%.
bosses.tank: Soak Hateful Strike: stay in melee with the highest health.
bosses.dps: Burn him; melee stay below the soakers' health.

bosses.name: Grobbulus
bosses.general: Mutating Injection: that player runs to the side to drop a poison cloud. Slime Spray in front spawns oozes.
bosses.tank: Kite him slowly round the room away from the clouds; face him away.
bosses.healer: Dispel the injection only once the player is out.
bosses.dps: Out of his front; kill the oozes.

bosses.name: Gluth
bosses.general: Zombie Chows walk in and feed him; Decimate drops everyone to 5%. Mortal Wound on the tank; Frenzy.
bosses.tank: Two tanks swap at Mortal Wound stacks.
bosses.healer: Heal the raid after each Decimate.
bosses.dps: Kite and kill the zombies; hunters Tranq the frenzy.

bosses.name: Thaddius
bosses.general: First Stalagg and Feugen on two platforms die together. Thaddius: Polarity Shift gives + or - charge: pluses stand left, minuses right; mixed charges hurt.
bosses.tank: Hold the two first, then Thaddius.
bosses.dps: Kill both platform bosses together; after each shift move to your side.

bosses.name: Sapphiron
bosses.general: Frost Aura drains everyone, Life Drain (decurse), Blizzard. In the air he Ice Bolts players into blocks: hide behind them from Frost Breath.
bosses.dps: Out of Blizzard; hide behind an ice block for the breath.

bosses.name: Kel'Thuzad
bosses.general: Phase 1: waves of undead come to the middle. Phase 2: Frostbolt (interrupt), Frost Blast, Mana Detonation, Shadow Fissure, Chains of Kel'Thuzad mind control. Phase 3: guardians.
bosses.tank: Off-tanks take the Guardians of Icecrown in phase 3.
bosses.healer: Spread; mana users with detonation run out.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Frostbolt; step out of Shadow Fissures; crowd control the chained.
